notes.title: Releasing the final Unity build of Keylogger
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Due to recent changes in Unity's terms of service I will not be continuing [i]Keylogger: a sci-fi visual novel[/i]. Some time in 2021 I decided to change my engine from Tyranobuilder to Unity for my visual novel, but I could not have foreseen they would change their terms and services so drastically.

That means I have to scrap my Unity project which I worked on for a year and either go back to Tyranobuilder, or find a different engine with more acceptable ToS.

The game's Unity engine build will be released for free as "early access" on this page, so you will be able to see the story (almost all of it). It's a very barebones early access release, but it's also a free year of effort, so... enjoy!

The future of [i]Keylogger: a sci-fi visual novel[/i] is even more uncertain with Unity's decision-making, but I'll find a way. :)

Thanks for reading and I hope you check out the basic Unity slideshow when Steam accepts the public build.


Thanks!


Sincerely,


Isaac
